title: Revised Code of Washington, Title 41 (Public Employment, Civil Service, and Pensions), Chapter 41.40 - Washington Public Employees' Retirement System
verified_how: fetched https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=41.40 (HTTP 200): breadcrumb 'Home / State laws and rules / RCWs / Title 41 / Chapter 41.40', heading 'Chapter 41.40 RCW - WASHINGTON PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM', with 'Complete chapter' HTML and PDF links, an 'RCW dispositions' link and a full section list. Currency: the RCW index page (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/) states 'Last update: July 15, 2026' and explains that 'The online version of the RCW is updated twice a year, once in the early fall following the legislative session, and again at the end of the year if a ballot measure that changes the law passed at the general election'; it also records that 'The Statute Law Committee declares that the certified PDF publication documents in the RCW Archive area on the Office of the Code Reviser's website constitute the official publication of the Revised Code of Washington', so this HTML version is the working rather than the certified text. The register flags amended-but-not-yet-merged text by printing a section two or three times with '(as amended by 2026 c NN)' suffixes.
notes: Old-age, survivors and disability insurance itself is federal (42 U.S.C. ch. 7); PERS is the principal Washington pension statute. Teachers (ch. 41.32 RCW), law enforcement officers and firefighters (ch. 41.26 RCW) and the Department of Retirement Systems (ch. 41.50 RCW) have their own chapters in the same title.
